foundry.name: UMC iSiPP300 silicon-photonics process platform
foundry.description: UMC announced transfer/licensing of imec iSiPP300 with CPO compatibility. Public release identifies microring filters/modulators, GeSi EAMs, low-loss fiber interfaces and 3D packaging modules. It is a foundry process platform; product-level performance depends on the customer design.
